items.title: 17.8 Uses of Group 2 Elements and Compounds (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu overview of the uses of Group 2 compounds (PDF 13).

blocks.text: Group 2 compounds ke sanat, rozmarra zindagi, dawa aur zaraat mein bohat se istemal hain, zyada tar un ke basic pan aur mukhtalif hall pazeeri ki wajah se.

blocks.prompt: Kaun si do khasiyatein Group 2 compounds ko itna mufeed banati hain?
blocks.explanation: Un ka basic pan aur mukhtalif hall pazeeri.

items: Istemal basic pan aur hall pazeeri par munhasir.
